_comment: Derived from what the corpus actually contains, not from what would be convenient. In 40 real SWE-agent trajectories the only high-frequency mutable entity is the file under edit: 21 distinct paths across 146 mentions, with the agent moving between them. Last-write-wins is exactly right for that -- an agent is working on one file at a time -- and a 30-turn-deep coding session genuinely needs to be told which one is current. This is the schema the benchmarks measure.
